# InlineAttachment

> Inline file and media previews for chat turns.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `inline-attachment` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/inline-attachment.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/inline-attachment.md`.

## Composition

### Attachment with actions

```tsx
<InlineAttachment>
  <InlineAttachmentMedia />
  <InlineAttachmentContent>
    <InlineAttachmentTitle />
    <InlineAttachmentDescription />
  </InlineAttachmentContent>
  <InlineAttachmentActions>
    <InlineAttachmentAction />
  </InlineAttachmentActions>
</InlineAttachment>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  InlineAttachment,
  InlineAttachmentContent,
  InlineAttachmentMedia,
  InlineAttachmentTitle,
} from "@/components/control-ui/inline-attachment";

export function InlineAttachmentExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-center gap-4">
      <InlineAttachment name="launch-brief.pdf">
        <InlineAttachmentMedia />
        <InlineAttachmentContent>
          <InlineAttachmentTitle />
        </InlineAttachmentContent>
      </InlineAttachment>

      <InlineAttachment name="app-icon.png" state="pending" aspect={1} className="max-w-48">
        <InlineAttachmentMedia />
        <InlineAttachmentContent>
          <InlineAttachmentTitle />
        </InlineAttachmentContent>
      </InlineAttachment>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### inline-attachment

- `--cui-inline-attachment-radius`: `min(
      var(--radius-field),
      calc(var(--cui-inline-attachment-padding) + var(--_inline-attachment-content-line-height) / 2 + var(--spacing))
    )`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-ring-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-error-ring-color`: `oklch(from var(--destructive) l c h / 0.45)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-document-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-document-background`: `var(--muted)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-document-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-hover-shadow`: `var(--shadow-md)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-content-radius`: `max(
      var(--radius-sm),
      calc(var(--cui-inline-attachment-radius) - var(--cui-inline-attachment-padding))
    )`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-content-background`: `oklch(from var(--background) l c h / 0.85)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-content-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-content-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-inline-attachment-image-outline-color`: `var(--image-outline)`
